name: Sky World 64
storyline: You wake up in a strange world where there’s nothing but an abyss of sky and a floating island. You are greeted by a friendly fairy named Trixie, who needs help turning this empty world into a beautiful place. By agreeing to help her, you are required to gather the few resources from the island and give them to her, and in return, she can create something larger for you that can help with your progress. Together, you both will be able to turn the sky world into a place you’ll never forget!
summary: Take a trip to Nostalgia Land in this cozy themed sandbox game that harkens back to the 64-bit era. This survival experience takes heavy inspiration from Minecraft’s Skyblock, where you start on a floating island with minimal resources and, over time, can turn your island into a world full of life!
